Name: Caustic Resolution
Components: V, S, M (a small carving of a head with a nail through it)
Description: If a creature is concentrating on a spell or benefiting from a magical effect that targets only them, you may attempt to cause the build-up of magical energy to burn away at their flesh. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, at the start of each turn when the creature is concentrating on a spell or benefiting from a magical effect from a spell, they take 1d6 acid damage. During this time, the creature has disadvantage on concentration checks. If they lose concentration or they benefit from no magical effects, this spell ends immediately.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 5th level or higher, the damage the target takes increases by 1d6 for every two spell slot levels above 3rd.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
